content:
Apple is now rolling out new beta software for developers, including beta 3 of iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and more.

iPadOS 27.2 and other systems welcome beta 3

The new round of beta versions is available to developers starting today, exactly two weeks after Apple's previous batch.

iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2 and other systems are now rolling out beta 3.

Highlights from the 27.2 betas so far include:

  • An all-new Health app with Apple Intelligence
  • Apple TV personal profile feature lands on iPhone and iPad
  • Siri AI brings Mac-style shortcuts to iPad
  • Siri AI supports more languages

Today's beta 3 update may add new items to the list above. If any new features are discovered, we will keep you updated.

Many unrevealed features are also likely tied to upcoming hardware announcements. Sources indicate Apple will release new home products, Macs, and more in the coming weeks.

Beta 3 has no public release yet, but it is expected to be available within a day or two.

Have you spotted any new features in iPadOS 27.2 beta 3 or other updates? Drop a comment and let us know.
